### God and Time
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/god-and-time
Passage: 2 Peter 3:8
Points:
- Peter addresses believers unsettled by skeptics who claimed Christ would never return.
- Human beings experience time sequentially, but the eternal God relates to time far differently.
- In light of God's eternal existence, a thousand years is as fleeting as a single day.
- Christ's return is always imminent from God's vantage point and for every generation.
- Understanding God's perspective on time encourages believers to pray patiently, trusting He always acts at the right moment.

### Time with God - October 29
Author: Crosswalk.com
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/timewithgod/time-with-god-october-29-2023.html
Passage: 2 Peter 3:8-10
Points:
- While humans view thousands of years as an extensive delay, God exists outside of time.
- God holds back His promised judgment because He deeply values people and desires their salvation.
- Divine mercy delays the Day of the Lord to give people opportunity to receive forgiveness through Jesus.
- The reality of future destruction should motivate believers to actively invite others to find safety in Christ.
